evals.name: repo-docs-folder
evals.prompt: Documenta este proyecto en una carpeta docs/ para que un nuevo desarrollador lo entienda rápido. Quiero un diagrama de arquitectura, una tabla con los endpoints de la API y una tabla con las variables de entorno. El proyecto está en C:\Users\Usuario\Develop\sonix-transcriber.
evals.expected_output: A docs/ folder with multiple Markdown files (or a structured doc) covering overview, architecture, API and setup. Includes at least one valid Mermaid diagram of the architecture, a Markdown table of the real endpoints (/transcribe, /folder/cleanup, /health) and a table of the real env vars (SONIX_EMAIL, SONIX_PASSWORD, SONIX_FOLDER_ID, SONIX_HEADLESS, SONIX_CACHE_DIR). Claims grounded in actual files.
assertions: Produces at least one Markdown file (ideally a docs/ folder with multiple files plus an index)
Contains at least one fenced ```mermaid code block
Every mermaid block is syntactically valid (parses without error)
Includes a Markdown table that lists all three real endpoints: /transcribe, /folder/cleanup, /health
Includes a Markdown table of env vars covering SONIX_EMAIL, SONIX_PASSWORD, SONIX_FOLDER_ID, SONIX_HEADLESS and SONIX_CACHE_DIR
Does NOT invent endpoints or env vars that are absent from the codebase
Cites real source files such as app/main.py, app/sonix_transcriber.py or app/config.py

evals.name: architecture-md-diagrams
evals.prompt: Necesito un solo archivo ARCHITECTURE.md que explique cómo funciona este servicio: un diagrama de flujo de datos del pipeline y un diagrama de secuencia de una petición de transcripción. El código está en C:\Users\Usuario\Develop\sonix-transcriber.
evals.expected_output: A single ARCHITECTURE.md containing a Mermaid flowchart of the 4-phase pipeline (upload -> transcribe click -> wait -> download) and a Mermaid sequenceDiagram of a /transcribe request. Both diagrams syntactically valid. Prose explains each step and cites real files (app/main.py, app/sonix_transcriber.py).
assertions: Contains a mermaid flowchart diagram of the pipeline
Contains a mermaid sequenceDiagram of a transcription request
Both mermaid diagrams are syntactically valid
Describes the real 4-phase pipeline (upload, transcribe-in-spanish click, wait transcribed, download)
Cites real source files (app/main.py and app/sonix_transcriber.py)

evals.name: notion-ready-writeup
evals.prompt: Quiero documentar este proyecto en Notion: una página con un overview, la arquitectura con un diagrama, y una tabla de endpoints. El proyecto está en C:\Users\Usuario\Develop\sonix-transcriber. (Nota: en este entorno de prueba el conector de Notion NO está disponible, así que en vez de crear la página, guarda el contenido Notion-ready de la página como un archivo .md.)
evals.expected_output: A Markdown file containing Notion-ready page content: a title handled as page property (no leading # title in body per Notion convention), an Overview section, an Architecture section with a mermaid code block, and a Markdown table of endpoints. Should mention the Notion publishing approach (parent page, mermaid code block) even though it didn't create the page.
assertions: Produces a Markdown file with the Notion-ready page content
Includes an Overview section and an Architecture section
Architecture section contains a fenced ```mermaid code block (which Notion renders as a diagram)
Includes a Markdown table of the real endpoints
Explains the Notion publishing approach: parent page_id, title as page property (not a leading # in body), mermaid in a code block
